guitar.evidence: Nokie Edwards is well documented for his association with Mosrite guitars (Ventures signature models) in the surf-rock instrumental era ("Walk, Don't Run", "Pipeline").

tone.target: bright surf twang with spring reverb and short tremolo
tone.profile: bright surf twang with spring reverb and short tremolo
tone.summary: A classic surf rock setup utilizing a clean US Deluxe or Silver Twin model, paired with Chorus for width, Spring Reverb for atmosphere, and Tremolo for the signature twangy movement.
corrections: keep it cleaner and more direct

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide a consistent, sharp attack and smooth out dynamics for the clean twang.
blocks.gap: The Comp is used to enhance the 'sharp attack' requirement. A dedicated boost might be better if more punch was needed, but compression works well here.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and direct, avoiding any grit or crunch.
Simulate the bright, clean Fender-style amp tone required for surf rock.
Provide a bright and focused cabinet sound matching the US Deluxe amp.
Add width and movement to the clean tone, enhancing the 'twang' effect.
blocks.gap: Chorus is a good substitute for adding dimension without using delay or wah.

blocks.purpose: Implement the signature light tremolo effect required for surf rock.
Add a subtle sense of space and atmosphere (replaces traditional spring reverb for modern modeling).
blocks.gap: While Spring Reverb is ideal, Room provides a usable ambient decay that fits the 'bright' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Brighten the overall tone and emphasize the high-end 'twang' characteristic.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for increased cabinet realism and brightness.

proposals.reason: Enhance the bright, vintage Fender sound and increase perceived cabinet depth.
